fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: devnet-11 activated Glamsterdam cleanly Monday; Lido and Optimism deployed and confirmed no issues; network kept up ~1 more week then shutdown
devnet-8: JUMP attack caused Besu OOM issues; t-store spam attacker causing ~7s block times (20 Mgas/s) on Besu; Besu has two PRs in flight
Sepolia Glamsterdam fork confirmed for October 6; client releases deadline September 29 (sooner strongly preferred for security review and bug bounty)
Hoodi fork tentatively targeting October 27; plan is to confirm go/no-go on the ACD October 8 call after observing Sepolia; avoids Devcon week

networking.highlight: Plan: QUIC default for all clients at Glamsterdam release; clients free to deprecate MPLEX after Glamsterdam activates on mainnet; spec PR 3866 merged post-fork

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8411 (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast via chunked gossip, 64 chunks + Merkle proofs): PFI'd; CFI decision deferred until after other pending CFI decisions
EIP-8015 (remove unused historical precompiles): CFI'd; strong client support, non-controversial

EIP-8365 (0x00 credential retirement): CFI pending scope reduction — force exits removed; only new 0x00 deposits blocked at Hegota; exits deferred to I-Star; author NC agreed; updated PR expected before next ACDC
DFI for Hegota: EIP-8237, EIP-8341, EIP-8367, EIP-8321, EIP-8243, EIP-8146, EIP-8375 (and EIP-8321 DFI'd with note that PQ-related work continues during H-Star)
Issuance EIP-8363 tabled; 3 clients DFI, 3 abstained; core devs not positioned to decide; process for broader community input to be determined; will be addressed in a future call

action_items.action: Publish Sepolia fork blog post, update eth-clients repo, and merge Meta EIP for October 6 fork
Cut Glamsterdam client releases by September 29 (target sooner for bug bounty/security review window)
Update EIP-8365 PR to remove forced exits; bring revised version to next ACDC for CFI

decisions.decision: QUIC default for all clients at Glamsterdam release; MPLEX deprecated (not removed) post-Glamsterdam mainnet activation; spec PR 3866 merged after fork
Sepolia fork set for October 6; Hoodi fork tentatively October 27, confirmed on ACD October 8 if Sepolia goes smoothly
PFI for Hegota: EIP-8411 (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast); CFI decision deferred until after other EIPs scoped
CFI for Hegota: EIP-8015 (remove unused historical precompiles)
EIP-8365 CFI pending with reduced scope (no forced exits in Hegota; exits deferred to I-Star); revised EIP to be confirmed CFI on next ACDC
DFI for Hegota: EIP-8237, EIP-8341, EIP-8367, EIP-8321, EIP-8243, EIP-8146, EIP-8375; PQ-related work (incl. hash-chain RANDAO) to continue informally during H-Star
EIP-8363 (issuance reduction) tabled; no decision today; stokes to propose a process for broader community input before next ACDC

targets.target: All Glamsterdam client releases — by September 29, 2026 (hard deadline)
Hoodi Glamsterdam fork — tentatively October 27, 2026 (go/no-go on ACD October 8)
